title: California Insurance Code Section 10113.4 (suicide contestability period carried into a group conversion policy)
updateCadence: Amended only by legislation. The section credit on the official host at the time of access read Added by Stats. 1997, Ch. 440, Sec. 1. Effective January 1, 1998.
claims: Section 10113.4 provides that if a group life insurance policy contains a provision that makes a certificate holder's coverage contestable on the grounds of suicide for a period following commencement of coverage, only the unexpired portion of that period shall be applied to a certificate holder's individual conversion policy of an equal or lesser amount of coverage.
